conventions.null: Not documented by any Fortune's Weave source checked.
conventions.tier: Skill Req letter on Game8 = minimum Authority rank of the carrier. 'authority' repeats it for lookup.
conventions.type: Game8 battalion Type: Phys, Mys, Recovery, Obstructor.
conventions.stats: Flat bonuses to the carrier (Game8 per-battalion page). null = page blank.
conventions.gambit.kind: Inferred from battalion type and gambit name unless an effect is published. '?' = inferred.
conventions.where: Settlement pools from Game8 per-battalion pages. Recruit Soldiers rolls at random from the pool; Renown and Rousing Speech shift it upward. 'region' is filled only where a Fortune's Weave source names it. 'chapter' is null for settlements because opening depends on your route's map and Renown gates.
conventions.three_houses: Rejected: Fandom's Gambit page tables (Line of Lances Mt 5 Hit 50, endurance) are Three Houses data. Nothing here comes from Three Houses or Three Hopes.
conventions.conflict_rule: Game8 per-battalion pages win for stats and pools; RPG Site and IGN win for story timing. Lower-tier sources fill only blanks.

access.fact: Battalions and the Gambit command are Theodora's route talent. Other Part I lords cannot recruit or use them.
Starters: Novice Hunters (Ch 4 tutorial), Priest Trainees (auto, Ch 5). Recruit Soldiers opens in Ch 6 (Regia tutorial). Transport Chief opens in Ch 7.

carriers.fact: Infantry only. Horse, Ornius and flying mounts can never hold one (Lysander is refused in the Ch 4 tutorial).
A unit can hold a battalion whose Skill Req is at or below its Authority rank (E to A). One battalion per unit.
Assign from Inventory > Assign. The Gambit command only appears once a battalion is assigned.

stat_bonus.fact: The carrier gets flat stat bonuses from the battalion. Higher tiers give more.
Cha bonus by tier on Game8 pages: E +3, D +4, C +5, B +7, A +8 (Fists of Black Smoke +9). Other stats add 2 to 8 points.
No battalion HP, endurance or Hit/Avo/Prt bonus appears on any Fortune's Weave page checked.
The unit's stat screen includes the battalion's bonuses (seen on Theodora, Sofia, Sirocco, Bonaventure and Tobias at Ch 11). Subtract them when comparing growth.

gambits.fact: Each gambit needs an exact tile pattern relative to the target before the command shows.
Limited uses per battle (IGN). One capture shows a counter going from 2 to 1.
Charm raises gambit effectiveness (IGN, Game8 via fortunesweave.co.uk). Our combat-stats file records Cha as raising gambit Hit.
Effective+ on a gambit triples the Mt behind it.

recruiting.fact: Recruit Soldiers on a settlement node starts a gauge. After a few turns one battalion from that town's pool joins at random.
Rousing Speech (Renown 5+): select the town again while recruitment is pending. Perfect result removes most or all low-level battalions from the pool. Bad result still removes a few.
Recruiting Drive: sometimes replaces Recruit Soldiers and combines it with Rousing Speech.
Renown 5, 7 and 9 each raise recruit quality and the number of battalions you can deploy at once. Exact counts not published.

search_points.fact: Send a battalion to a Search node or dungeon node. It returns with materials after some turns, scaled by type and its Gather Cap.
Priest and clergy battalions gather more at resource nodes. Mage battalions gather more ore.
Send Supplies quests (all due 10/24) more or less need battalion searching.

transfer.fact: Transport Chief (Ch 7+) takes surplus battalions for troop points. Higher tiers pay more. 100 points = 1 Tactics Manual (Authority).

carryover.fact: Battalions carry over to Part III (Game8, thegameswiki).

Community: Part III receives each route's end-of-Part-I inventory. A battalion assigned to a unit stays on that unit's Clear Data instead of going to the pool. If you skip that unit in Part III, buy the battalion back at the Drifting Reliquary for Karma Shards.
Part II use is not documented.
